bpmn2:process.name: CONSORT participant flow
bpmn2:process.bpmn2:documentation: Figure 3(b): the example study's participant flow in Studyflow, grouped into the four CONSORT 2025 phases (enrolment, allocation, follow-up, analysis). Counts travel on the flow itself: each kept arrow names its count (assessed, randomized, self-paced/speeded, completed, analyzed) and each red attrition arrow carries its branch's count, so the branches stay separate while the error end events report the totals. Attrition is encoded as boundary error events wired to counted error end events - the topology of the published CONSORT flow is the topology the runner executes, and at run time the runner fills every n = ... and each exit's attritionCount. CONSORT's itemized 'give reasons' texts nest in each error end event's documentation (expanded once here as the annotation on the screening exclusions); clicking an element in the modeler reveals its breakdown. The phase bands are bpmn:Group artifacts, a projection device that only annotates and never changes the control flow.

- [x] every kept arrow carries its branch count - [x] every attrition arrow carries its branch count - [x] every exit's reasons itemized in its documentation - [ ] as-run: runner has filled n = ... and attritionCount

bpmn2:endEvent.name: Excluded (n = ...)
bpmn2:endEvent.bpmn2:documentation:
Give reasons (itemized in the annotation):
- not meeting inclusion criteria (n = ...) - declined to participate (n = ...) - other reasons (n = ...)
The incoming arrow carries the count; the runner writes this exit's attritionCount at run time.

bpmn2:endEvent.name: Discontinued intervention (n = ...)
bpmn2:endEvent.bpmn2:documentation:
Give reasons, per arm (arm counts are on the two incoming arrows):
- withdrew consent (n = ...) - technical failure (n = ...)
One aggregated error end event; click it in the modeler to see the per-arm breakdown. The runner writes this exit's attritionCount at run time.

bpmn2:endEvent.name: Excluded from analysis (n = ...)
bpmn2:endEvent.bpmn2:documentation:
Give reasons, per arm (arm counts are on the two incoming arrows) - each reason is its own rejection path out of the analysis filter:
- RT < 100 ms (n = ...) - missing data (n = ...) - flagged rows (n = ...)
One aggregated error end event; click it in the modeler to see the per-reason, per-arm breakdown. The runner writes this exit's attritionCount at run time.

bpmn2:textAnnotation.bpmn2:text: not meeting inclusion criteria (n = ...) declined to participate (n = ...) other reasons (n = ...)
